summary: Frontend RETEST of Movie Studio (Video Forge) — all previously-reported HIGH issues are FIXED. Full end-to-end flow now succeeds on project 8c6962fe-8be5-48e0-994d-a9938f149b83 (Movie Studio Demo). Movie Studio is the first tab; Scenes/Shots/Render Queue tabs still open with no regression. Generate Plan (target=24, clip=8) renders the Production Plan card IMMEDIATELY without a page reload (~12s including backend call). Generate Render Jobs renders Production card + per-shot job list. Produce Movie drives the produce loop from the frontend; stat chips update from Total=3 to Completed=3 and the Final Master card appears within ~32s. The <video> element has src=/api/files/f61f9254-149a-42a1-ab66-1904294a71c6 which returns HTTP 200 with content-type=video/mp4, and a Download MP4 button is present. The Produce button transitions from 'Producing…' to 'Movie Ready' (no longer stuck). Persistence verified: after full page reload the plan, jobs, Final Master card and <video> src are all restored from backend without re-running anything. Regression: switching to Scenes, Shots, Render Queue tabs works and returning to Movie Studio still shows the completed final master.
critical_code_review_comments: Generate Plan silently no-ops when Video idea textarea is empty (no visible validation feedback / no toast). Minor UX polish — consider disabling the button or showing an inline error when idea is empty.
Console logged only benign warnings during the run; no errors observed.
